units.source_text: 那人是美国人和日本人生的混血儿，约莫是叫乔治·莫瑞。

en.t: The man was of mixed American and Japanese parentage, and I believe his name was George Murray.

units.source_text: 听说他曾志得意满的跟我一个熟悉的路透社记者说过这么一件事，

en.t: I heard that he once smugly told a Reuters correspondent I knew a story like this:

units.source_text: 他以前在南京和一个信仰基督的妓女共度一夜，

en.t: He had once spent a night in Nanjing with a prostitute who believed in Christ,

units.source_text: 趁着女子睡着的时候，他悄悄跑掉了。

en.t: and while the woman was asleep, he quietly ran away.

units.source_text: 上一回我来这边的时候，那人跟我刚好都住在上海的同一个酒店，到现在我还记得他长得什么样呢。

en.t: The last time I came here, he and I happened to be staying in the same hotel in Shanghai, and I still remember what he looked like.

units.source_text: 那人总是显摆自己是英文报纸的记者，尽管长得人模狗样儿，但是人品却着实不行。

en.t: He was always showing off that he was a reporter for an English-language newspaper; although he looked respectable enough, his character was truly bad.

units.source_text: 那人最后染上了恶性梅毒，后来成了疯子，可能是传染了那个女子的病也不好说。

en.t: In the end he contracted malignant syphilis and later went mad; perhaps he had caught the woman's disease.

units.source_text: 不过直到现在这个女子还认为那个卑劣的混血儿是耶稣基督。

en.t: Yet even now this woman still believes that despicable mixed-race man is Jesus Christ.

units.source_text: 我究竟是告诉她事实的真相呢，还是应该缄口不言，让她一直活在那个古老的西洋传说的美梦里呢？”

en.t: Should I tell her the truth of what happened, or should I keep silent and let her go on living in the beautiful dream of that old Western legend?
